product.olivetti-laptop-d33-c.summary: The D33/C brought a TFT display to the high-performance portable line.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33-c.history: Olivrea dates the German D33/C brochure to 1991. In May 1992, MCmicrocomputer reported it had been shown in Hanover and estimated a price below ten million lire.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33-c.architectu: The TFT provided active-matrix colour. The November configuration has 640 × 480 and 256 colours, and a detachable keyboard.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33-c.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33-c.limitation: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
